style:
Modern upbeat synth-pop, bright synthesizer arpeggios, straight four-on-the-floor electronic drums, electric bass, clear expressive female lead vocal in English, 120 BPM. A concise verse and chorus, instrumental development, then a resolved outro. Clean contemporary studio production.
Complete 60-second musical cue; resolve the arrangement at the end.
lyrics:
[Verse]
Open the window, welcome the day
The morning is calling, we're on our way
Follow the rhythm, out of the gray
There's a little more light with every step we take

[Chorus]
Here comes the sunshine, over the street
Here comes the moment, moving our feet
One little spark and a world to explore
We keep on finding a little bit more

[Instrumental]

[Outro]
A little bit more
